Class LocalGameState

java.lang.Object
network.client.core.LocalGameState
public class LocalGameState extends Object
Client-side view of the game state. Populated by deserialising GameStateDto snapshots received from the server.

The internal AtomicReference guarantees that every getter always reads a consistent, fully-written snapshot with no synchronisation overhead on reads.
